be curious about: Children are naturally curious about the world around them.
孩子们对周围的世界天生好奇。
be willing to do sth: She was willing to help us move the furniture.
play a part (in): Everyone can play a part in keeping the city clean.
每个人都能为保持城市整洁出一份力。
add to: His silence only added to our worry.
他的沉默只是加剧了我们的担忧。
take on (a project): The firm took on a new project last month.
这家公司上个月承接了一个新项目。
flow in both directions: On this street, traffic flows in both directions.
这条街上的车流是双向的。
clear away: Please clear away the dishes after dinner.
work against: A tight deadline can work against good design.
紧迫的工期会妨碍好的设计。
stay up (late): Don't stay up late the night before the exam.
change with the times: A language must change with the times.
end up doing sth: We ended up walking home in the rain.
我们最后冒雨走回了家。
He is no longer a student but a teacher.
他不再是学生，而是老师了。
no longer … but …: He is no longer a student but a teacher.
他不再是学生，而是老师了。
join in: Come and join in the game if you like.
喜欢的话就一起来玩这个游戏。
turn out to be: The stranger turned out to be my old classmate.
那个陌生人原来是我的老同学。
wear out: Years of farming had worn out the soil.
多年耕作使这片土地贫瘠了。
give up: Never give up hope, even in the hardest times.
即使在最难的时候也不要放弃希望。
run on its own: After a week of training, the machine can run on its own.
经过一周的调试，这台机器能自行运转了。
carry sb along: Her enthusiasm carried the whole team along.
她的热情带动了整个团队。
hand over to: He will hand over the company to his daughter next year.
他明年会把公司交给女儿。
earn its place: This small shop has earned its place in the neighbourhood.
这家小店在社区里赢得了一席之地。
take shape: The plan began to take shape after several meetings.
几次会议之后，计划开始成形。
credit sb with sth: Scientists credit her with the discovery.
科学家们把这一发现归功于她。
slow the effects of: Trees help slow the effects of climate change.
树木有助于减缓气候变化的影响。
find one's way: It took us an hour to find our way back to the hotel.
我们花了一小时才找到回旅馆的路。
change hands: The old cafe has changed hands three times.
那家老咖啡馆已经转手三次了。
put pen to paper: He finally put pen to paper and wrote her a letter.
他终于提笔给她写了封信。
play a bigger role in: Local groups should play a bigger role in protecting the river.
地方组织应在保护这条河上发挥更大作用。
be linked to: The illness is linked to poor diet.
这种病与不良饮食有关。
catch one's eye: A bright red poster caught my eye.
一张鲜红的海报吸引了我的注意。
They turned the old factory into a museum.
他们把旧工厂变成了一座博物馆。
rest on: The whole argument rests on one weak assumption.
整个论证建立在一个薄弱的假设之上。
cut out: You can cut out the middleman and sell online.
你可以省去中间商，直接在网上卖。
